entries.text: After CreateMeshPartAsync, sanity-check part.Size against the 5-stud character BEFORE judging looks: hand weapons belong at ~2.5-4 studs total; the first procedural scimitar shipped at 9.6 studs (double player height) and read as absurd.

A generated blade only reads as a blade with a converging apex point, thin cross-section (thickness well under width), and a distinct guard+pommel breaking the hilt silhouette; a thick rounded shaft with a blunt tip reads phallic.
